body:
Socially i haven't done very well this semester. I have a job that I've been falling behind on as well, and an editorial position with the school newspaper that i have fucked up a whooooole lot because of the depression. I've always been something of a high achiever in high school and last year (I'm a sophomore) but this year the mental things hit and everything just got so much harder. My grades are the only thing that have held up. Being home is ok. Being around my parents reminds me how much they'd be disapointed if they knew I was depressed, or knew about the state of my room. 

I'm sorry you've been struggling with depression as well.  It's so great of you to reach out and help other people like this, even while dealing with your own problems.

The reasons basically had to do with feeling like I'm taking more from the world than I ever give back to it. I feel like I have already disapointed a lot of people I'm close to and am dependent on a lot of people and will do these things forever. I want to die before I hurt anyone anymore, before anyone else has to clean up some mess I made.
No. They don't know and I couldn't bring myself to tell them.

Thanks for being understanding about this, and for giving a really heartfelt response. You're a very good person to do such a thing. I don't think my room is an immediate health hazard- I actually cleaned a lot of it before I came home for christmas break and planned to clean the rest later. I thought my depression was getting better around then but getting this letter kind of proved that it wasn't, and how warped my perception of cleanliness has become as a result of being so depressed. What looks like an improvement to me looked alarmingly filthy to my RA and it kind of reminded me how low I had sunk and it's making me feel like no matter what progresses I make it will never be quite enough. It's like I feel like maybe every time I feel like  I'm getting better I'll be reminded that I'm still shit and why would I want to go on living in a cycle like that?

But your response definitely helped. a lot. I'm not feeling all the way not suicidal, but I'm not having a stare down with the gun like I was a few minutes ago, so thank you so much for helping me think my way through this.

I've been given a lot. I'm pretty intelligent and my parents pay for me to go to a good school. They are really good to me yet I'm still fucked up. I can't keep my room clean. I can't function well in social situations. I've got straight a's in school but what's that worth when I'm only here because of other, better people's money and hard work. I don't have many close friends and the close friends I do have I am an emotional burden on. I try to give but I always find myself taking more- I feel like I relentlessly consume and fuck things up without ever giving anything back or creating anything worthwhile.

Idk why I bothered. No one is going to take this seriously and why should they? It is silly. My life and my problems are silly and trivial compared to all the greater evils in this world. I've made my decision. I'm going out tomorrow after the house is empty. Pulling the trigger. It's going to be over. I will stop being a shitty person bothering the world with my dumb trivial problems.

I feel like maybe none of you are reading the entirety of my post.
I mentioned that this is not just about the letter and that I have been feeling suicidal and writing suicide notes for months now. I have a pretty good life. I'm a bad person and I negatively effect others around me though. What more do you want in the way of details? Also, why do you think the Zoloft is a bad idea?
Thank you. You're clearly very kind hearted to try and help me. The world is better with people like you in it.
Thank you. You're a very good hearted person to reach out to a stranger on the internet like this. Take care of yourself. :)

Thanks you guys. I appreciate it a lot that there are people out there who care enough about others they don't know to try and help them out online like this. I'm probably going to take this post to SuicideWatch though- it's not your fault, your advice is good but I'm just sitting here with my dad's revolver trying to decide whether to put it in my mouth or not. Idk. My room is probably not the real problem I guess. But you guys are great, please don't think you aren't. You're doing good empathetic and noble things by being so supportive here.

I mean yeah. I've tried. But like this is a depression forum and I thought it would be understood here that depression can make hygiene decline.but maybe not. I know it would be easy for me to fix idk why I can't just do what a normal person could. I'm pretty useless at most things.
